name: Hepatocyte extension catalog
description: QuPath 0.6+ extension for the hepatocyte-app deep-learning liver H&E segmentation model — slide import, MPP-aware tissue detection, and per-ROI or whole-project inference under Extensions → Hepatocyte.

extensions.name: QuPath Hepatocyte extension
extensions.description: Runs the sbalci/hepatocyte-app segmentation model on QuPath annotations and imports predictions back as classified cell polygons with per-class counts and Excel reports. Requires a local hepatocyte-app checkout (Python venv + TorchScript model, 🔒 on request); configure paths in Settings.
extensions.author: Serdar Balci
